tags: [sealed]

# Contracts

Nobody can read this page. Not engineering, not commercial, not an admin — the
admin group appears in no content ACL, and `/-/*` access is a different power from
reading content.

The folder must therefore be absent from every listing and every nav tree, and
`/handbook/commercial/legal` must 404 for every principal.
